description:
After the corpus mirror PR #2837 merges (tracked by t3-drift-corpus-mismatch-20261009), dispatch nightly-v2.yml with run_drift=true (scheduled runs evaluate drift on Mondays only, so the issue would otherwise stay open until the next Monday). Confirm all five drift checks pass in the t3:drift job: corpus, privacy, validator, cross-surface baseline and pricing. The Report job should then close issue #2471. If a check fails, record which one and why on the issue rather than re-dispatching.

Result of the first dispatch, run 37991400931: the pricing, validator, privacy and baseline checks passed; the corpus check failed.
